decisions.executionNote: Remember left-to-right colors: green, blue, red. Begin left cover approach, raising and rotating gradually into elbow-up configuration; right arm stays home.
Move above left cup while completing downward gripper orientation, preserving elbow-up branch and open fingers.
Lower around the left cup and close fully; verify grasp by lifting next, not from commanded aperture.
Lift the left cup upright, then move it toward the green block, the first block in left-to-right covering order. Keep closed throughout.
Cup is visibly retained. Lower it over the left green block, release upright, and begin withdrawing vertically.
Left green block appears covered. Clear its cup vertically, then approach the middle cup from above with the left arm; right stays clear.
Align over the middle cup and descend to grasp height, then close fully. The middle block to cover next is blue.
Lift the middle cup without rotating, then carry it over the middle blue block. Keep the gripper fully closed and the right arm at home.
Middle cup visibly retained above blue. Lower and release it upright as the second covering step, then withdraw vertically.
Two leftmost blocks appear covered. Clear the middle cup and retreat leftward while the right arm begins a gradual elbow-up approach to the rightmost cup.
Replan after continuity rejection: halve left retreat increments. Continue right approach on the same elbow-up branch; both grippers remain open.
Move left arm clear in its own workspace. Align right gripper vertically above the remaining cup using small continuous rotations before descending.
Descend around the rightmost cup with its orientation unchanged, then close fully. Left arm remains safely clear.
Lift the rightmost cup upright and carry it over the red block for the third covering step. Maintain fully closed grip and watch retention.
Lower retained right cup over red and release upright, completing left-to-right covering. Withdraw slightly to inspect before uncovering red first.
All three blocks appear covered. Regrasp the rightmost cup and lift to uncover red first; green and blue cups remain untouched.
Move red's retained cup backward to an empty spot, lowering upright. Bring the left arm above green's cup without touching it yet; blue remains covered.
Release red's cup at the rear and clear it vertically. Descend and grasp the left cup to uncover green second; leave middle blue covered.
Lift green's cup to uncover green second, then carry it rearward upright. Blue stays covered. Begin a gradual right-arm return toward home.
Green and red are visible; blue remains covered. Set green's cup down upright at the rear and release. Continue right arm to its origin with small increments.
Clear the released green cup and approach the middle blue cup from above with the left arm. Right arm settles at origin; red and green stay uncovered.
Align and descend around the final middle cup, then close fully. Red and green are already visible; blue will be uncovered last after retention is checked.
Lift the middle cup to uncover blue last, then move it to the empty rear middle position without rotating. Keep closed and verify retention visually.
Set the retained blue cup upright in the rear middle spot, release, and withdraw vertically. Then return the left arm home and inspect all blocks.
Clear the released middle cup vertically, then return leftward while gradually restoring home orientation. Keep both grippers open and preserve elbow-up continuity.
All blocks are now visible and cups stand at the rear. Continue the left-arm return along a gradual elbow-up path; correct the small right home offset.
Finish returning the left arm to its original pose with small continuous increments, then settle both arms. Cups are upright and all three colors remain exposed.
